title: Robinhood Markets, Inc. to Present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9, 2026
summary: MENLO PARK, Calif., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Robinhood Markets, Inc. (“Robinhood”) (NASDAQ: HOOD) today announced that it will be participating in the upcoming Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.
body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Robinhood Markets, Inc. (“Robinhood”) (NASDAQ: HOOD) today announced that it will be participating in the upcoming Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.


Robinhood’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Vlad Tenev is scheduled to present on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at 10:50 AM PT / 1:50 PM ET. Interested parties may access a live audio webcast of the presentation by visiting[investors.robinhood.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BHF7IAD2pAbbfYguqawqyfRiiS7A06A_7BosI4Oy7w3MM44mltLz-qZm_e-ZT67v1b9DPF5Xlnw9ooqDwbX-ulRmpgfaLldSWTnvsguKQ7o=) . Following the presentation, a recording will be available for replay for at least 90 days on the same website.


**About Robinhood**


Robinhood Markets, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOOD) is a global leader in financial services offering retail brokerage, crypto, advisory, digital banking services, and private markets access to a new generation of investors. Additional information about Robinhood can be found at[robinhood.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HwP16JjR3j2eJlZXNQqsNsw3Ep14GJWAcye9RpPBezPPeuUxOOOACFdKLA-ViBCpRHmwn6Z83A5U5ba29keyvw==) .


Robinhood uses the “Overview” tab of its Investor Relations website (accessible at[investors.robinhood.com/overview](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BHF7IAD2pAbbfYguqawqyfRiiS7A06A_7BosI4Oy7w090iFJF9YRmTEUyNX3PqiRfVA9gPcbLqLlYHI5-9Ea4IsBGWvrxrrowZAKmzNZIfg3HxunrxNUTbax8ZoOQ0FGEjAkL38hKND0vOg_cKyiuA==) ) and its Newsroom (accessible at[robinhood.com/newsroom](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HwP16JjR3j2eJlZXNQqsNnmcaE6Rp9lH_92kWPZIpHpRLItuZFNADeYMnE305RdIa6snLGeXvIXJQFELkhkY_oRbZGXNI_sDrcM4s5F2PVQ=) ), as means of disclosing information to the public in a broad, non-exclusionary manner for purposes of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Regulation Fair Disclosure (Reg. FD). Investors should routinely monitor those web pages, in addition to Robinhood’s press releases, SEC filings, and public conference calls and webcasts, as information posted on them could be deemed to be material information.
